extraRules: All builds, tests, vet, node checks, protocol validation, ISA builds and screenshots run via BB_HOST=x-boss BB_JOBS=2 just bb. This overrides generic workflow rules and final-gate examples that permit local ISA builds or unprefixed build2/validate-protocol. Production CGO_ENABLED=0; race checks only CGO_ENABLED=1 CC=/usr/bin/gcc on x-boss. Go -p 2, Node --test-concurrency=2.

No attn, no live changes, no capture or secrets access without a separately authorised operator step. Never read secrets/, *.secret, .data/, env files or ~/.config/vecnet. Never touch dev hub 45752 or preview 49575.
No npm or pnpm install; headless Chromium through scripts/ui/lib.mjs only. Isolated SHOTS_DIR; never open windows.
Never change connectors/**, internal/opseed/**, real fly.toml or real hub credentials/peers/database. Do not deploy to the real app.
Public demo uses a dedicated mux; no httpapi.New or NewStack.Run. Default deny unknown routes/methods. No operator bearer in browser and no implicit UI writes.
Only reviewed actual-session fixtures with digest-bound human approval may launch publicly. Synthetic fixtures are test-only. No automatic export approval or production DB copying.

Actual website CTA source, fixture approval, Fly organisation/network/quote and DNS are pending publication gates; model/data-policy checks apply only to the unscheduled live-chat follow-up. Report pending accurately; do not invent live acceptance evidence.

Unconditional code gates use demo-deploy-check --offline and explicit synthetic test paths. Actual approved fixture/network/site-link readiness is a pending publication gate until operator supplied; --public must fail closed without it. Never weaken --public to make the implementation gate green.

Replay-only first launch: immutable allowlisted display DTO snapshots in memory using existing UI contracts; no hub/DB reconstruction, volume, provider key/client, visitor session, activity SSE or progressive scheduler. live_enabled=false always; chat routes absent. Appendices are unscheduled follow-ups.

Separate known-asset and API budgets. Measure actual-binary cold-load request counts and enforce documented sizing margins. TestDemoColdLoadProductionLimits uses production quotas, cold cache, no mocked assets; dashboard and generation-reset refetch must succeed. Queue/coalesce dynamic reads and bound Retry-After retries.

lensFocus.spec: Check the eight launch tasks: isolated Fly app/network, anonymous all-view access, approved actual-session fixture, constant timestamp shift, immutable in-memory UI contracts, no runtime model spend. Chat and progressive replay appendices are excluded from scheduling and launch prerequisites.
lensFocus.security: Attack default-deny mux, DTO/export leaks, arbitrary URLs/browser media, unknown asset/API abuse, memory bounds and generation mixing. Prove no authority, hub credentials/store reconstruction, provider client/chat routes or persistent volume. Preserve real auth and network isolation.
lensFocus.tests: Each named test fails before implementation and proves behaviour; guard normal hub auth. All commands through BB_HOST=x-boss BB_JOBS=2 just bb, fakes only, temp roots, no local builds. Browser journey catches hidden writes, remote loads and false live labels. Measure cold-load assets/API reads and test unchanged production limits, all dashboard reads and reset refetch against actual binary; no mocked assets. Verify snapshot contracts and old-generation cursor rejection.
